title: a scratch-HOME proof subprocess carries no bus address from its caller
intention: A proof that gives a subprocess a scratch HOME gives it no bus address the parent carried, so a scratch-HOME run never reaches a live far bus.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akienasus: this session's env carried CAIRN_BUS_HOME=akiendelllinux.local:7419, and test_root_verb_vocabulary.py:165 _run builds dict(os.environ, HOME=str(home), PYTHONPATH=...), so the scratch-HOME subprocess dialled the Dell's live bus and test_get_status_is_uniform_across_the_roster red over the Dell's cairn status (cached False), while the Dell's own 21:46 seal read it green. Under CAIRN_BUS_HOME=nowhere.invalid:7419 the same tooth fails 'the bus at nowhere.invalid:7419 did not answer'. A scratch HOME is not isolation while the bus address rides an env var. Same family as 3deafc9e36de (a foreign checkout's client meets a live bus); this is the env side.
traces_to: Law 3 (a proof measures the code under it, not whatever bus the caller's env points at) and Law 8 (a red manufactured by the env is a fake failure, and the same leak can manufacture a green).
how: (a) cairn/tools/scratch/scratch.py: def home_env(home, **extra) -> dict, after git_env: {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('CAIRN_BUS_')}, then HOME=str(home), then extra (str values) applied last. The charter's 'what' names it, written through the artifact door. (b) The six tools/base proofs that build a scratch-HOME env from os.environ take it: test_root_verb_vocabulary.py:165, test_root_verbs.py:144, test_a_view_takes_arguments.py:122, test_help_answers_as_list_with_shortcuts.py:80, test_shim_starts_the_loop.py:75-78, test_a_loop_a_test_run_starts_is_the_runs.py:70-71 (home_env, then drop _ENV). The generated fixture source at test_a_loop_a_test_run_starts_is_the_runs.py:126 is a string and stays. (c) Red-first proofs: cairn/tools/scratch/proofs/test_home_env_carries_no_bus_address.py (clause 1) and cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_scratch_home_proof_reaches_no_live_bus.py (clauses 2 and 3).

clauses.claim: scratch.home_env(home, **extra) returns the caller's env with every CAIRN_BUS_* key removed, HOME=home, every other key kept, and extras applied last, so an explicit CAIRN_BUS_HOME extra survives
test_root_verb_vocabulary.py::test_get_status_is_uniform_across_the_roster passes with CAIRN_BUS_HOME=nowhere.invalid:7419 in the parent env
no function in cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_*.py copies os.environ and sets a HOME key on the copy; a scratch-HOME env is built through scratch.home_env

decisions.text: D1: scratch gains home_env beside git_env; its charter's 'what' names it.
D2: the six tools/base scratch-HOME env builders take home_env.
D3: two proofs, one tooth per clause: clause 1 in-process in tools/scratch; clause 2 a pytest -k subprocess under the unreachable address and clause 3 an ast scan, both in tools/base.

out: the 19 scratch-HOME env builders outside tools/base (devices/cc, recovery, trouble, cairn, codemother, sleep_cycle, aider_shim, skill_block, bin/proofs): each component adopts home_env in its own ticket (RULE 1)
cairn/tools/bus_client/remote.py (how a client reads its address is unchanged)
